title: Зачем мы меняем план
description: Зачем мы меняем план: применяем правило в самостоятельных ситуациях, работаем со словарём и читаем авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Выражать цель через in order to
Вводить цель с отдельным подлежащим через so that
notes: In order to + инфинитив обозначает цель действия: We moved in order to make space.
So that может вводить отдельного исполнителя: We spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: We printed larger labels so that everyone ___ read them.
exercises.explanation: После so that и подлежащего everyone нужен глагол could read.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение словом из пары: for / to.

public_payload.sentence: The group moved the chairs in order ___ create more space.

exercises.editorial_answer: The group moved the chairs in order to create more space.
exercises.explanation: In order to сочетается с начальной формой create.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Мы говорили медленно, чтобы все могли понять объяснение.»
exercises.editorial_answer: We spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.
exercises.explanation: So that вводит отдельное подлежащее everyone; цель относится к пониманию слушателей.

exercises.prompt: Исправь указанную конструкцию, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: She opened the side door in order make access easier.

accepted: She opened the side door in order to make access easier.

exercises.reference_answer: She opened the side door in order to make access easier.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She opened the side door in order make access easier.
exercises.editorial_answer: She opened the side door in order to make access easier.
exercises.explanation: После in order требуется to перед инфинитивом make.

public_payload.passage: At a community workshop, the organiser noticed that some visitors could not read the small labels. She printed larger ones and moved a lamp nearer the table. She also asked speakers to slow down so that everyone could follow the instructions. These changes took only a few minutes, but visitors said they made the activity easier to join.

options.label: So visitors could follow the instructions.
So the labels would become physically larger.
So the workshop would end immediately.

exercises.editorial_answer: So visitors could follow the instructions.
exercises.explanation: Цель названа после so that: понимание инструкций.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова урока с переводом в указанном контексте.
exercises.editorial_answer: purpose — цель; access — доступ; follow — понимать ход объяснения; adjust — корректировать
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: purpose — цель; access — доступ; follow — понимать ход объяснения; adjust — корректировать.

public_payload.passage: At a community workshop, the organiser noticed that some visitors could not read the small labels. She printed larger ones and moved a lamp nearer the table. She also asked speakers to slow down so that everyone could follow the instructions. These changes took only a few minutes, but visitors said they made the activity easier to join.

options.label: They required the workshop to close for a week.
Every visitor had previously understood every label.
They took a few minutes and visitors found them helpful.

exercises.editorial_answer: They took a few minutes and visitors found them helpful.
exercises.explanation: Текст описывает небольшие по времени меры и положительный отзыв, не всеобщую прежнюю доступность.

exercises.prompt: Объясни цель с отдельным подлежащим participants.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Why did you add a written summary?

options.label: So that participants could check the main points later.
In order participants could to check later.
Because of participants to checking later.

exercises.editorial_answer: So that participants could check the main points later.
exercises.explanation: So that participants could ... — полноценная целевая часть.

public_payload.sentence: Making the doorway easier to use improves ___ to the room.

exercises.explanation: Access — возможность попасть в помещение или пользоваться им.
